BiblicalUsage: Job is named once, in Genesis 46:13. In Genesis 46:13 we read, "And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron."
TheologicalSignificance: Job is on God's list, and I believe he writes down names the world would leave out.
